INFINITY, InSite, Resilient and EAGLECELL are certified on the HP Latex R530.

Tested Fujifilm Onset X2 / Acuity print modes, UV settings and adhesion results for INFINITY and InSite Reveal.
Published HP Latex R2000 print settings for InSite Reveal, INFINITY and InSite Canvas.
